text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with
Manhattan
Cafe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Manhattan Cafe's gaze to find a
claw
machine filled with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
With a cute plushie like that, I won't
have to
worry about it suddenly growing
its hair out...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. Just something from the
past...
Anyways, do your best.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
